mapper.sql: id, member_id, order_id, order_item_id, order_sn, application_type, product_name, product_attr, reason, description, customer_supplement, status, status_note, fulfillment_status, fulfillment_note, fulfillment_updated_at, application_key, open_scope_key, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, create_time, update_time, cancelled_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at
mapper.insert: insert ignore into ai_after_sales_application ( member_id, order_id, order_item_id, order_sn, application_type, product_name, product_attr, reason, description, customer_supplement, status, status_note, fulfillment_status, fulfillment_note, fulfillment_updated_at, application_key, open_scope_key, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, create_time, update_time, cancelled_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at ) values ( #{memberId}, #{orderId}, #{orderItemId}, #{orderSn}, #{applicationType}, #{productName}, #{productAttr}, #{reason}, #{description}, #{customerSupplement}, #{status}, #{statusNote}, #{fulfillmentStatus}, #{fulfillmentNote}, #{fulfillmentUpdatedAt}, #{applicationKey}, #{openScopeKey}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, now(), now(), #{cancelledAt}, #{reviewedBy}, #{reviewedAt} )
mapper.select: select from ai_after_sales_application where application_key = #{applicationKey} limit 1
select from ai_after_sales_application where open_scope_key = #{openScopeKey} limit 1
select from ai_after_sales_application where id = #{id} limit 1
select from ai_after_sales_application where member_id = #{memberId} order by create_time desc, id desc
mapper.update: update ai_after_sales_application set status = 'CANCELLED', status_note = '客户已取消申请', open_scope_key = null, cancelled_at = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and member_id = #{memberId} and status = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
update ai_after_sales_application set reason = #{reason}, description = #{description}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and member_id = #{memberId} and status = 'PENDING_REVIEW'

update ai_after_sales_application set customer_supplement = #{supplement}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and member_id = #{memberId} and status = 'ACCEPTED' and fulfillment_status <> 'SUCCEEDED'

update ai_after_sales_application set status = #{applicationStatus}, fulfillment_status = #{fulfillmentStatus}, fulfillment_note = #{fulfillmentNote}, fulfillment_updated_at = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status in ('ACCEPTED', 'COMPLETED')
